（本文是游历休闲文，主角游历山川湖海，一路上会遇见各种人、妖、仙，并会发生一些有趣的事情，主角会不同程度的参与进去，并非烂好人一个，是今日我帮他，他日他助我，的因果循环。）
......
“公子，去哪儿？”
“闲云野鹤，云游四海。”
清风拂过，万木倾伏，山路崎岖，却也并不难走。
纪风也不知道去哪儿。
昨晚他还在公司加班，电脑上密密麻麻的表格看的他眼花缭乱，但总是过不了老板的法眼，让他再重新做一版。
“看来旅游的计划又要推迟喽。”
纪风叹息一声，端着咖啡往工位上走去，争取今晚做完，忽然脚下一滑。
再睁眼时，已经躺在了山沟沟中。
头顶的天蓝的发亮，周围都是古柏，上边不时传来清脆的鸟叫声。
纪风躺了半天，才确定这不是梦。
“我这是穿越了？”
纪风揉了揉太阳穴。
“这是什么？”
纪风发现他闭上眼时，脑海深处多了本‘书’。
‘书’上用古篆写着几个大字：
【山海万灵录】
他想着翻开看看，这是什么东西。

那‘书’竟真的翻开第一页，上边写着：
【名山大川，江河湖海，妖精鬼怪，仙神灵魔。凡所见者，皆可录入，可得法术神通、机缘仙物。】
下边还有一行小字：
【打坐无用，闭关白费。唯有亲历，方有所获。】
纪风看了三遍，他明白了。
正所谓读万卷书，不如行万里路，想要变强，就要游历。
“妖精鬼怪，仙神灵魔，法术神通......这个世界，有点意思。”
之前为了生计，天天加班，做好的旅游攻略一次次被搁置。
现在既然有这样的机会，那就到处走走，看看吧。
纪风起身拍了拍屁股上的土，认准一个方向走去。
也不知道走了多久，终于在山路上碰见一个人。
是一个中年汉子，身着粗布短衣，打扮如同古人一般。
身后背着竹篓，篓里装着檀香、红烛、干粮，还有一块腊肉。
腊肉早已洗净，用草绳拴着，吊在竹篓外边，一晃一晃的。
“原来公子不是俺青城县人，俺就说你穿的为何如此......奇异。”
纪风看了眼自己。
白衬衫、西装裤，锃亮的皮鞋。
苦笑一声：“呵呵，是有些奇异，穿皮鞋走山路。”
这不是他也没有准备，就穿越过来了。
汉子又道：“公子莫非也是去山灵大王庙的？”

“山灵大王？”
“公子不知道？”
见纪风疑惑，汉子来了劲儿：“山灵大王啊，可灵了！”
“俺们县里一猎户，上山打猎，遇到了大虫，被咬断了腿，要不是同行猎户急忙惊走大虫，怕是整个人都要被吃掉。”

"Master, where are you going?"
"The idle clouds and wild cranes travel all over the world."
The breeze blew, thousands of trees fell, and the mountain road was rugged, but it was not difficult to walk.
Ji Feng didn’t know where he was going.
He was still working overtime at the company last night, and he was dazzled by the densely packed forms on the computer, but he couldn't get past his boss, who asked him to make another version.
"It seems that the travel plan will be postponed again."
Ji Feng sighed and walked to his workstation with his coffee, trying to finish it tonight, when suddenly his foot slipped.
When he opened his eyes again, he was already lying in the ravine.
The sky above the head is bright blue, surrounded by ancient cypresses, and the clear chirping of birds can be heard from above.
Ji Feng lay there for a long time before confirming that this was not a dream.
"Have I traveled through time?"
Ji Feng rubbed his temples.
"What is this?"
Ji Feng found that when he closed his eyes, there was an extra 'book' in the back of his mind.
There are several big characters written in ancient seal script on the ‘book’:
[Record of Mountains and Seas]
He thought about opening it to see what it was.
The 'book' actually opened to the first page, which read:
[Famous mountains and rivers, rivers, lakes and seas, fairies and ghosts, fairies, gods and demons. Everything you see can be entered, and you can get magical powers and magical creatures. 】
There is also a line of small print below:
[Meditating is useless, retreating is in vain. Only through personal experience can you gain anything. 】
Ji Feng read it three times and he understood.
As the saying goes, it is better to travel thousands of miles than to read thousands of books. If you want to become stronger, you must travel.
"Fairies and ghosts, fairies and demons, magic and supernatural powers... This world is a bit interesting."
In the past, I worked overtime every day to make a living, and the travel strategies I prepared were shelved time and time again.
Now that you have such an opportunity, let’s walk around and see.
Ji Feng stood up, patted the dirt on his butt, and walked in one direction.
I don’t know how long I walked, but I finally met someone on the mountain road.
He is a middle-aged man, wearing a short coat of coarse cloth, dressed like an ancient man.
Carrying a bamboo basket behind him, the basket contained sandalwood, red candles, dry food, and a piece of bacon.
The bacon has already been washed, tied with a straw rope, and hung outside the bamboo basket, dangling from side to side.
"It turns out that the young master is not from Qingcheng County, so I asked you why you are dressed so... strangely."
Ji Feng glanced at himself.
White shirt, suit pants, shiny leather shoes.
He smiled bitterly: "Haha, it's a bit strange, wearing leather shoes and walking on a mountain road."
It’s not like he traveled through time without preparation.
The man asked again: "Is it possible that the young master also went to Shanling Dawang Temple?"
"The King of Mountain Spirits?"
"Master, don't you know?"
Seeing Ji Feng's doubts, the man got excited and said, "Shanling King, you are so smart!"
"A hunter in our county went hunting in the mountains. He encountered a big insect and his leg was bitten off. If the fellow hunter hadn't hurriedly frightened the big insect away, he would have been eaten whole."
